mapper.select: /* id="selectRecent" - 추후 대시보드 최근 활동 영역에서도 그대로 사용 가능 */ SELECT ACTIVITY_ID, MEMBER_ID, ACTIVITY_TYPE, ACTION_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT ACTIVITY_ID, MEMBER_ID, ACTIVITY_TYPE, ACTION_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CREATED_AT FROM ACTIVITY_LOG WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ACTIVITY_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
